node.title: Re: Best suite
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: When you ask so generally: I personally very much perfer [mod://Mojolicious] nowadays, its API is fun to work with and it supports most of the modern web technologies. I have a bunch of Mojo examples linked from [id://830550|my scratchpad]. As for Apache, see the section [mod://Mojolicious::Guides::Cookbook#Apache/mod_proxy|"Apache/mod_proxy" in Mojolicious::Guides::Cookbook].
